posts.author: TheLivingN64
posts.body:
I want to create a script that makes a state act like paralysis from Pokemon (25% chance to skip the afflicted actor's turn every turn the state is active). I'm using Yanfly's Battle Engine.
There's some other Pokemon skills I'd want to create, so if there's a giant Pokemon resource (aside from Crystal engine) for RGSS3, I'd appreciate it.
Thanks in advance!

posts.author: TheLivingN64
posts.body:
Updating to post that I found a solution to the problem and will be sharing my results for all future, aspiring Pokemon RPG Maker VX Ace devs.
You'll need the Victor Engine Basic Module and the Victor Engine State Auto Apply.
You'll also need two states. A paralysis state and a "skip turn" state. Set your skip turn state to "cannot move" and turn/action end.
Within your actual paralysis state, place the following in the notes:
<apply auto state action start: x>
rand(y) < z;
</apply auto state>
Where x is the state id for your "skip turn" state, y is your random range, and z is the % range you want to check for.
This worked quite nicely. This isn't my solution, though, as I found it within PersoNo 0 and its Fear state. All credit goes to RegretTourmaline.
